gameName: Sol: Last Days of a Star
firstPlayerRule: Whoever has been closest to the Sun most recently is the first player.
clarifications: The optional Vestigial Structures setup places gates and stations in turn order, beginning from the chosen first player.
In a solo game there is no multiplayer starting order to select.
